name: @etzhayyim/messenger-kotoba
description: kotoba impl of messenger (Consensys c-split). Public channel directory plaintext (sdk.write/read) + message bodies (content + metadata, channel/DM/thread) sealed via kotoba E2E (sdk.encryptedWrite/Read, ADR-2605181100), read-cap = owner DID + channel members / DM participants. Real-time fan-out delivery + abuse-enforcement actions stay etzhayyim via consent-capability. Founder directive 2026-06-03: front everything that can move.
